title: IonQ Stock Falls 6.4% as CFO Inder Singh Steps Down (Nov 13)
summary: IonQ (IONQ) fell 6.42% to $28.88 on Nov 13, 2026, after the company said CFO Inder Singh is stepping down effective immediately.
body_markdown:
IonQ's[Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1824920/000119312526461016/ionq-20261110.htm) , filed with the SEC after the close, adds that Merrill is expected to start on December 3, 2026, and that Chairman and CEO Niccolo de Masi serves as interim principal financial and accounting officer until then. As reported by[Benzinga](https://www.tradingview.com/news/benzinga:207409763094b:0-ionq-shares-drop-on-sudden-leadership-shake-up/) , IonQ shares were down 8.17% at $28.35 during Friday's session after the announcement.


Not every outlet put the whole move on the finance change.[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/13/ionq-falls-8-as-quantum-computing-stocks-slide-rigetti-drops-6-d-wave-declines-4/) reported IonQ down 8% in early trading, with Rigetti down 6% and D-Wave down 4%, and linked the slide to profit-taking after a recent bounce and a wider pullback in[high-beta](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/beta-meaning/) speculative tech tied to[fallout around Nvidia](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-13-2026/) .


## IONQ Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- In its third-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on November 5, IonQ posted revenue of $173.83 million, up 336% year over year with the SkyWater foundry business consolidated, and raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $505 million to $515 million, per 24/7 Wall St.
- IonQ had a pro forma cash position of $3.7 billion, according to 24/7 Wall St., and Merrill called IonQ's balance sheet a distinct advantage in the quantum industry in the company's release.
- According to IonQ, Merrill and Austin bring public company finance and accounting experience that will matter as the company scales and pursues profitability.


### Risks


- The CFO seat changes hands without overlap: Singh left effective immediately, and his successor is not expected until December 3, per the 8-K.
- Losses remain wide. Third-quarter adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $133.61 million from $48.91 million, and GAAP net income of $563.96 million leaned on a non-cash warrant liability gain of $896.16 million, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- The same 8-K discloses a prospectus supplement filed November 13 covering the possible resale of 34,580,646 IonQ shares by selling stockholders.
- 24/7 Wall St. noted that quantum computing stocks have been trading as a single block, and IonQ was down 34% year to date in early Friday trading.
